defect_description: The frozen core/engine_timesfm.py omitted num_layers=50, context_len=2048, and use_positional_embedding=False required for TimesFM 2.0 500M checkpoints. The frozen engine instantiated an incompatible architecture and could not execute the intended M1 TimesFM baseline.
resolution: Protocol 001 terminated pre-outcome. No registered BTC holdout outcomes were inspected. Protocol 001's BTC holdout will remain unopened permanently to prevent leakage into future protocols.
